query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Publish approved carousel content from a Trello workflow to LinkedIn, add a first comment, update Trello status/logs, and adjust the Trello board workflow structure.
query_ground_truth.query: get approved cards from Trello workflow
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve all content cards marked as approved from the designated Trello board and list.

requirement_groups.purpose: retrieve cards from a specific Trello list

request.query: get approved cards from Trello workflow

results.use_case: get approved cards from Trello workflow
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the authenticated member using TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_ME (get the member identifier for assignment filtering).

[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the target list identifier using TRELLO_GET_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST (ensure the list exists); [Optional (if only list name is known and board id is available)] [Prerequisite]: Map list name→list identifier using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.
[Required] [Step]: Fetch cards assigned to that member using TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_CARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER (retain card identifiers and idList when present).
[Required] [Step]: Filter assigned cards client-side to those whose idList matches the target list identifier(s).
[Fallback (if idList is missing/ambiguous on returned cards)] [Fallback]: Hydrate each candidate card using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD (read idList) and re-filter.

[Optional (if list is very large or to reduce per-card hydration)] [Step]: Pull cards in the target list using TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST and intersect with the member-assigned set by card identifier.
[Optional (if audit context is needed)] [Next Step]: Retrieve recent history using TRELLO_GET_CARDS_ACTIONS_BY_ID_CARD (explain why a card matches).
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_CARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER] Card results may be nested under a container (often under a data/cards field) rather than being a top-level array.
[TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_CARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER] Returned card objects may not include a reliable idList, requiring follow-up via TRELLO_GET_CARDS_BY_ID_CARD.
[TRELLO_GET_LISTS_BY_ID_LIST] Validates only a list identifier; if starting from a list name you must map it via TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD (board id required).
[TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST] Large lists can yield very large responses; intersect by card identifier and avoid repeated full-list pulls.

TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_CARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER.description: Retrieves cards for a Trello member, specified by ID or username, with options to filter cards and include related data like actions, attachments, and checklists.

limit.description: Max cards to return (1-1000). Trello's default applies if omitted.

since.description: Return cards updated after this ISO 8601 date. 'null' or omit for no lower limit.

before.description: Return cards updated before this ISO 8601 date. 'null' or omit for no upper limit.

fields.description: Card fields to return. 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., `name`, `due`, `idBoard`, `labels`).

filter.description: Card filter: 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open', or 'visible'. 'visible' means cards on open boards member can see.

actions.description: Filters actions on cards. 'all' or comma-separated Trello action types (e.g., `commentCard`, `createCard`).

members.description: Include member details on cards: 'true' or 'false'.

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member. Use 'me' for the authenticated user.

member_fields.description: Member fields if 'members' is true. 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., `fullName`, `username`, `initials`).

attachment_fields.description: Attachment fields if including attachments. 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., `name`, `url`, `date`).

TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Retrieves lists from a specified Trello board, with options to filter lists and include card details.

cards.description: Determines which cards should be returned within the lists. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields of the lists to be returned. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: closed, idBoard, name, pos, or subscribed.

filter.description: Filters the lists to be returned based on their status. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. Valid formats: 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '60d5f2f1c8a8b4002b8f0123') OR 8-character shortLink (e.g., 'TH6F0pTM'). Human-readable board names or URL slugs (e.g., 'my-board', 'tech-jcorp') are NOT valid identifiers. In the URL 'trello.com/b/TH6F0pTM/my-board', 'TH6F0pTM' is the valid shortLink, while 'my-board' is just a slug and cannot be used. To find your board ID or shortLink: use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER to list your boards, or look at the board URL in your browser.

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields of cards to be returned if the 'cards' parameter is not 'none'. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url.

TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_ME.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated Trello member. Use when you need profile details, settings, or member metadata.

cards.description: Optional parameter to include cards. Accepts 'all', 'none', or card filter values like 'open', 'closed', 'visible'.

boards.description: Optional parameter to include boards. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of board filters.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return. Use 'all' for all fields. Valid field names: id, activityBlocked, avatarHash, avatarUrl, avatarSource, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idEnterprise, idEnterprisesDeactivated, idMemberReferrer, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, nonPublic, nonPublicAvailable, products, url, username, status, aaId, aaEmail, email, gravatarHash, idBoards, idBoardsPinned, idOrganizations, loginTypes, oneTimeMessagesDismissed, prefs, premiumFeatures, trophies, uploadedAvatarHash.

actions.description: Optional parameter to include actions. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of action types.

boardStars.description: Optional parameter to include board stars. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

customEmoji.description: Optional parameter to include custom emoji. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

boardsInvited.description: Optional parameter to include boards the member is invited to. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

customStickers.description: Optional parameter to include custom stickers. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

boardBackgrounds.description: Optional parameter to include board backgrounds. Valid values: 'all', 'none', or 'default'.

customBoardBackgrounds.description: Optional parameter to include custom board backgrounds. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.
